about_the_game:
Dive into a 2D Fantasy world and create your own story within this sandbox world. Team up with your friends to embark on epic journey, build and conquer the world. Echoes of the Hive has endless possibilities, your journey begins as you step into a mysterious, procedural generated world. Together you will be able to venture across a diverse landscape, from the surface above to the deepest darkest caverns hidden below. Uncover rich biomes, each with their own distinct enemies and resources.

Explore intricate dungeons scattered across the landscape, each one packed with deadly enemies, hidden traps, and powerful loot. Craft weapons, armor, and tools from resources you gather, and upgrade your equipment to stand a better chance against increasingly difficult foes. Be prepared to face off against formidable bosses that emerge as you progress; each has unique abilities and attack patterns that require skill and strategy to defeat.

Key features:

  • Sandbox Play

  • Randomly generated worlds

  • Free Content Updates

  • Multiplayer
